profile.description:
Vytor's Herald who brandishes a steel scythe.
Olga, the daughter of a wealthy arms manufacturer, obtained the weapon imbued with Vytor's Will, the Scythe of Rapacity, and was chosen as Vytor's Herald. A woman of extreme greed, she is never satisfied until she has obtained whatever she desires.

cards.desc: 120% Damage. If the last card activated was a Rhythm card, activate that card 2 times

cards.name: Encore II
cards.desc: **Unique** For every 2 Rhythm cards activated, 100% Damage to the enemy with the lowest HP (15 times per turn).

cards.name: Encore III
cards.desc: For the next 3 Rhythm card(s) activated, decrease Cost by 1 and add 1 Hit.

cards.name: Encore IV
cards.desc: **Unique** Activate all Rhythm cards in Graveyard.

cards.name: Encore V
cards.desc: Draw 1. If that card was a Rhythm card, increase Damage Amount by 100% until activated for 1 turn and repeat 1 more time (max 2 times).
